description: GE#536 stage 1: an E6ACTad (Dragon 2 last mile) on the td/rozklad timetable of td.scn, switched to its genset by the scenery before it leaves: PutValues MainSwitch 0, TractionMode 1, GensetSwitch 1 from event0 of its track, 1 s apart. The AI, which knows nothing of the genset, closes the line breaker once the genset runs and drives to Przystanek on at most 442 kW at the wheels (520 kW x 0.85). Needs the temporary variant e6actad_g6.fiz/.mmd in dynamic/pkp/e6act_v2 of the game (not in the SVN, see tests/scenarios/README.md).

vars.consist: node -1 0 {{vehicle}} dynamic pkp\e6act_v2 e6actad-017 e6actad_g6 0 headdriver 0 0 enddynamic
